description: Pulls the relevant changes from a pull request or a commit range, with the context a reviewer needs, into one verified review packet. This is the portable Agent Plugins 1.0.0 packaging of the skill.

com.anthropic.claude-code.note: The Claude Code native shapes live at the repo root beside the portable package and are declared here under the reverse domain namespace the specification section 8 defines. Hosts that do not implement this namespace ignore this object. The shapes are the agent persona, the output style, the mod hooks, the headless runbook and the fan out workflow, with the native plugin manifest naming the install path.

com.google.antigravity.note: The Antigravity native shapes live at the repo root beside the portable package and are declared here under a documented placeholder namespace. No primary source names a reverse domain namespace for an Antigravity plugin, so this key follows the section 8 reverse domain convention and is not presented as primary. Hosts that do not implement this namespace ignore this object. The shapes are the Antigravity plugin manifest and the PreToolUse hook wiring.
